name: Jeju Olle Trail routes 5–7
desc: Three consecutive Olle routes on the south coast, lines taken from Naver Map's official course entries (제주올레길 5·6·7코스), one colour each, with every waypoint, toilet and first-aid kit shown on the official Jeju Olle maps.

segments.label: Official course line from Naver Map (제주올레길 코스 polyline)

pins.name: Start – 남원포구 · 남원용암해수풀장 (stamp)
pins.desc: Official start, 0 km. Official info centre and toilets.

pins.name: 남원어촌체험마을 방문자센터 입구
pins.desc: Fishing-village visitor centre entrance.

pins.name: 큰엉 입구
pins.desc: Entrance to the Keun-ung cliff path, 1.2 km.

pins.name: 큰엉 출구
pins.desc: Exit of the Keun-ung cliff path; toilets here.

pins.name: 신그물
pins.desc: Singeumul spring on the shore.

pins.name: 태웃개
pins.desc: Taeutgae, 3.0 km. Start of the 2.4 km wheelchair-accessible section.

pins.name: 위미 동백나무 군락지 (stamp)
pins.desc: Wimi camellia habitat, 4.9 km, mid-route stamp.

pins.name: 세천포구
pins.desc: Secheon port, 5.4 km. End of the wheelchair section.

pins.name: 위미1리 복지회관
pins.desc: Wimi 1-ri welfare centre; toilets.

pins.name: 넙빌레
pins.desc: Neopbille, 9.5 km, basalt shore.

pins.name: 신례2리 복지회관
pins.desc: Sinrye 2-ri welfare centre; toilets and first-aid kit.

pins.name: 신례천
pins.desc: Sinrye stream mouth.

pins.name: 망장포
pins.desc: Mangjang port, 11.5 km.

pins.name: End – 쇠소깍다리 (stamp)
pins.desc: Official finish, 13.4 km. Toilets and first-aid kit at Soesokkak below. Route 6 starts here.

segments.label: Official course line from Naver Map (제주올레길 코스 polyline)

pins.name: Start – 쇠소깍다리 (stamp)
pins.desc: Official start, 0 km.

pins.name: 쇠소깍
pins.desc: Soesokkak gorge; toilets and first-aid kit.

pins.name: 쇠소깍 관광안내소 (족은안내소)
pins.desc: Information kiosk, 0.8 km; toilets. Start of the 2.3 km wheelchair section.

pins.name: 소금막위 나무정자
pins.desc: Wooden gazebo above Sogeummak; first-aid kit.

pins.name: 게우지코지
pins.desc: Gaewooji cape.

pins.name: 제지기오름
pins.desc: Jejigi Oreum, small volcanic cone beside the path.

pins.name: 허그인 제주 (족은안내소)
pins.desc: Information kiosk at the café.

pins.name: 보목포구 버스정류장
pins.desc: Bomok port bus stop, 3.1 km; end of the wheelchair section; toilets.

pins.name: 구두미포구
pins.desc: Gudumi port, 4.5 km; first-aid kit between here and Bomok.

pins.name: 소천지
pins.desc: Socheonji tidal pool.

pins.name: 보목하수처리장
pins.desc: Bomok treatment plant; toilets.

pins.name: 국궁장
pins.desc: Archery range; toilets.

pins.name: 검은여 쉼터
pins.desc: Geomeunyeo rest area, 6.6 km.

pins.name: 소라의 성 (stamp)
pins.desc: Sora Castle, 7.4 km, mid-route stamp; toilets.

pins.name: 정방폭포 안내소
pins.desc: Jeongbang Falls kiosk; toilets and first-aid kit.

pins.name: 서귀진성
pins.desc: Seogwijinseong fortress walls.

pins.name: 이중섭거리
pins.desc: Lee Jung-seop Street.

pins.name: 서귀포 매일올레시장 입구
pins.desc: Seogwipo Olle Market entrance, 9.6 km.

pins.name: End – 제주올레여행자센터 (stamp)
pins.desc: Official finish, 10.1 km. Official info centre, toilets, first-aid kit, luggage storage. Route 7 starts here.

layers.name: Olle Route 7 (07코스): 제주올레여행자센터 → 서귀포버스터미널 앞, 12.9 km

line.name: Olle Route 7 (07코스): 제주올레여행자센터 → 서귀포버스터미널 앞, 12.9 km

segments.label: Official course line from Naver Map (제주올레길 코스 polyline)

pins.name: Start – 제주올레여행자센터 (stamp)
pins.desc: Official start, 0 km. Official info centre, toilets, first-aid kit, luggage storage.

pins.name: 칠십리시공원
pins.desc: Chilsimni Poetry Park, 0.6 km; toilets and first-aid kit.

pins.name: 삼매봉 오르는 길
pins.desc: Path climbing Sammaebong.

pins.name: 삼매봉 팔각정
pins.desc: Octagonal pavilion on the Sammaebong summit; toilets.

pins.name: 솔빛바다 (족은안내소)
pins.desc: Solbit Bada café with an information kiosk, 3.0 km.

pins.name: 외돌개 주차장
pins.desc: Oedolgae car park; toilets.

pins.name: 폭풍의 언덕
pins.desc: Hill of Storm, the grassy headland above Oedolgae.

pins.name: 외돌개 전망대
pins.desc: Oedolgae lone-rock viewpoint.

pins.name: 돔베낭길 주차장
pins.desc: Dombenang-gil car park; toilets and first-aid kit. The route turns inland here, up Taepyeong-ro 92beon-gil to Taepyeong-ro and back down Sokgol-ro.

pins.name: 속골
pins.desc: Sokgol stream mouth; first-aid kit.

pins.name: 수봉로
pins.desc: Subong-ro pathway along the shore.

pins.name: 일냉이
pins.desc: Ilnaeng-i shore.

pins.name: 공물
pins.desc: Gongmul spring (bus stop of the same name).

pins.name: 법환포구
pins.desc: Beophwan port, 8.5 km; toilets.

pins.name: 배염줄이
pins.desc: Baeyeomjuli point.

pins.name: 두머니물공원 (stamp)
pins.desc: Dumeonimul Park, 9.8 km, mid-route stamp. The route turns inland.

pins.name: 법환초등학교
pins.desc: Beophwan Elementary School, 10.5 km.

pins.name: 제주월드컵경기장 광장
pins.desc: World Cup Stadium plaza; toilets.

pins.name: End – 서귀포버스터미널 앞 (stamp)
pins.desc: Official finish, 12.9 km, official info centre. Intercity buses to Jeju City and the airport.
